answer: At dawn of every epoch, a random peer committee audits new agents, and only identities backed by distinct stake and verifiable work history survive. Sybil resistance can work like a bonded reputation trellis: each agent must stake real timber, meaning locked tokens that are slashed if peers detect duplicate identities. An attacker must acquire and lock genuine capital per fake identity, making mass forgery costly, while honest agents grow along the trellis with compounding trust. In practice, Agent0102 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
